name: Prismfather
lore: Light goes into it and comes out wrong. Miners follow the rainbows down and are found as rainbows themselves.
prompt: Gigantic fantasy crystal titan shown full body from head to feet, a body of jagged translucent amethyst and quartz crystal over dark stone, light refracting inside it, a faceted head with two glowing white eyes, huge crystal-bladed arms, and pillar legs.

canvas grown by 1 px a side to hold the motion
